verdict.rationale: CIPO's own pages advertise bulk data in three places: an 'IP Horizons – Bulk data' entry on the trademarks page, 'downloadable bulk data' alongside the Canadian IP databases, and the option to 'download patent office records' on the patents page. Together these show it publishes registry extracts that need no scraping. The evidence is only link labels, though, with no detail on what the extracts contain or how to retrieve them. Missing for 10: documented file formats, coverage and update cadence, any evidence of bulk statistics extracts, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the downloads work.
